rationale: Both candidates correctly verify that the major GT threads (NPU/XPU/MUSA platform scope, connector live-state, full-payload-branch unreachability, prefix-cache incompatibility) were already resolved in this diff, but X digs deeper and catches residual problems in those exact areas — the 'only consumer' ownership claim is contradicted by three other call sites, and the corrected image path (GT4's original fix) still 404s on GitHub — plus a novel, well-cited TP>1 connector-broadcast risk, all with precise file/line grounding.
